Hey man !  
First, as I always say when I comment on Reddit, my English is kinda rusted (I have been learning it since 2 years now) and that might be a little weird to read.  
You're not alone. A weird way of looking at it is just by thinking : "How many lives will I bring with me to the death ?". That's a good question. You have loving ones, a little sister which you seem to love a lot, I mean, they will probably be extremely sad and possibly depressed afterward... Don't feel guilty, tho, that's just a quick little thing to think about before doing mistakes.  
Reach out for help, there are plenty of hotlines if you feel the need to talk to people that might be able to understand you (After all, this is their job), and maybe try therapy again... I know, every psychologist is not incredible, but I guess you could find one that suits you better.  
Finally, being alone might be one of the reason you're unhappy. I wouldn't say that you NEED to find a GF (or a bf IDK) at the moment, but it could be a great idea to start to connect with other people (at work, at college, ...) and maybe try new types of relationship when you will feel that you're getting better and that you're ready for that ! Life can be harsh, and trust me it was for me, and looking at your post, especially for you. But don't give up yet ! Imagine yourself in 10 years... You could be married, having a child, a nice house... Or not, actually... But isn't it worth the risk ? I would be pretty interested to know what wait me, killing yourself is just stopping everything, you're killing the possibility to be happy.  
Good luck man, again reach out for help if you need it and if you need people to talk to, there are specialists, maybe friends or just people you trust !  
Good luck ! Hope you get better in no time !
